notes.title: New Creature : Snail
notes.content:
[b]New Creature[/b]
In the discord channel, my friend Freeman mentioned that tunnels are too safe to escape from creatures. then  fuyu suggested the snail as a slow but dangerous creature a long time ago. here is “catch me if u can”, it moves very slowly but it can hurt you a lot.

[b]Improvement[/b]
[list]
[*] Some minor bugs have been fixed.
[*] baseball bat animation was moving too slowly, fixed.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=PW1KQ-SAq8s;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Health Issue
notes.content: First of all, thank you for your interest in this game. you never know what difficulties life will bring. one of my family members has faced a serious health problem. so I had to leave the city where I work. probably I will not be able to deal with the project for a month. whatever you believe, your prayer will be very precious to me.

notes.title: Bug Fix (0.0.3.3)
notes.content:
I would like to thank [b]mafuyuchan[/b] and [b]bigbasch [/b]for their help in fixing these bugs.

* fixed engine spawning in front of the door.
* on the new day, engines were not deleted from the map, fixed.
* engine and piston noise reduced.
*items on the dead player were not dropping correctly. fixed.
*you could use any item as an engine part. fixed.

notes.title: Demo Update Fix And Improve
notes.content:
I finally figured out how to share the content of the update I installed. hahah ^^ anyways;

* I added sound to the objects collected for the engine.
* I added explanations to some unclear interact objects.
* The chainsaw creature was only attacking the first person it saw. now if it locks onto someone and you hit the creature, it will turn its focus to you.
* I added a blinking effect to make it easier for you to recognize the steps you need to take after completing the engine.
* fixed a problem with the stamina bar filling up
* I fixed the problem of the imposter dwellers' unidentified noise.
* end of day feature added.
*it was too dark, so I added a light to brighten the environment.
* your settings will now be saved.
* the engine could not be interacted with because it spawned inside objects. fixed.
* made the game a little easier.
